description: Re-send a stored event to its destinations. Replays sit outside the monthly event quota but within a daily replay limit per plan, and replaying an event that was held for quota bills it as a new event. The destination does run its handler again: a receiver that is not idempotent will process the event twice while debugging.

api_key.description: API key (ahk_live_...) from anyhook_quickstart. Only needed over HTTP when no Authorization header is set; ignored over stdio.

id.description: Event ID to replay. Replay does not consume event quota.

name: anyhook_replay
title: Replay an event
